statement.zh: 考古研究将朝鲜半岛无纹陶器时期表述为以农业定居、素面陶器与支石墓等为标志的青铜时代社会转型，并讨论其后早期国家形成（Nelson 1993；Barnes 2001；JAR 2024）。
statement.en: Research frames the Mumun pottery period on the Korean peninsula as a Bronze Age social transformation marked by agricultural sedentism, plain pottery, and megalithic burials, with later early-state formation discussed in syntheses (Nelson 1993; Barnes 2001; JAR 2024).
